identity.title: Recover safely after RunRecord publication before Result

origin.summary: The remaining 2D reconciliation identifies a high-risk external-integration gap between durable RunRecord publication and Result publication.

state.current_summary: 2D-041 is resolved as a bounded process-recovery slice. Normal publication remains Completed/Pass; a one-shot Result-write failure removes the tentative RunRecord and leaves one typed terminal ExecutionFailed Result; a worker killed after durable RunRecord publication leaves the record, the first restart publishes one manual-recovery Failed/ExecutionError/ExecutionFailed Result without rerunning, and a second restart is rejected with unchanged Result bytes. The existing TwoDIntegrationExchange, RunRecord/Result writers, and .2d-run.lock lease remain the owners. Power-loss, native-worker, reconnect, throughput, offline-PC, hardware, and broad WPF/UI qualification remain separate unverified boundaries.

objective.summary: Prevent duplicate 2D inspection after a process stops after RunRecord publication but before Result publication, while preserving the original record and a typed terminal recovery-required Result.
constraints: Reuse TwoDIntegrationExchange and VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke; do not add a parallel exchange, database, or global lock.
Keep RunRecord and Result immutable-file ownership and the existing .2d-run.lock lease.
An existing RunRecord without a Result must be validated for Handoff artifact identity and must never cause an automatic rerun.
Use the existing ExecutionFailed controlled failure outcome with an explicit manual-recovery message because the shared contract has no separate RecoveryRequired error code.
Use only an internal test seam for deterministic process-boundary and Result-write fault injection; it must not affect normal runs.
Do not modify, stage, commit, or push C:\Git\2D\Original.
Do not claim power-loss, native-worker, reconnect, throughput, hardware, offline-PC, or broad WPF qualification from this contract.

criteria.text: Normal 2D publication remains Completed/Pass, and a one-shot Result write failure cleans the RunRecord and leaves exactly one typed terminal failure Result.

A child process killed after durable RunRecord publication and before Result publication leaves the orphan record; the first restart publishes one recovery-required ExecutionFailed Result without re-execution, and a second restart is rejected without changing the Result bytes.

The issue record, reconciliation report, current handoff, and stable contract identify the owner/call path, manual recovery policy, focused process fixture, D-drive evidence, self-evaluation, and unverified operational boundaries so 2D-041 is not repeated.

context.summary: The existing exchange remains the execution and mutable-state owner. The new preflight is immediately after artifact resolution and before image decode/native execution; the existing RunRecord writer and Result publisher remain the only writers.

A valid or invalid orphan record is retained. The adapter publishes one terminal Failed/ExecutionError Result with ExecutionFailed and an explicit automatic-rerun-blocked/manual-recovery message; it never guesses a completed Result or runs the recipe again.
This is the shortest source/test path for the changed recovery boundary.

artifacts.summary: Debug and Release build/runtime logs for the focused RunRecord recovery contract.
Debug and Release JSON reports containing normal, Result-write-failure, process-kill, recovery, and second-restart observations.

evidence.observation: The pre-change call path had separate atomic RunRecord and Result writes, so a process stop after WriteRunRecord could leave no Result and a later request could execute again. The bounded change keeps the existing owner and lease, validates an existing record against Handoff source/recipe identity, blocks automatic rerun with a terminal ExecutionFailed recovery message, and adds internal-only pause/one-shot write-failure seams for deterministic fixture coverage.

VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke x64 Debug and Release builds completed with 0 errors using the isolated clean-source-state shim required by the runtime identity contract. Each build reported the existing 19 nullable warnings in unrelated smoke contracts and produced the runner used by the process fixture.

The Debug contract exited 0. It recorded normal=Completed/Pass, Result-write-failure=Failed/ExecutionFailed with no retained RunRecord and one Result, markerObserved=true with killedWorkerExitCode=-1 and orphanRunRecordRetained=true, recovery=Failed/ExecutionError/ExecutionFailed with one Result, and secondRestartRejected=true.
The Release contract exited 0 with the same normal, write-failure, process-kill, recovery, orphan-retention, single-result, and second-restart rejection observations as Debug.

The durable project records identify PL-0101 as the sole 2D-041 owner, retain the existing exchange/lease ownership, describe the manual recovery boundary, link both Debug/Release reports, and explicitly leave power-loss, native-worker, reconnect, throughput, offline-PC, hardware, and broad WPF/UI qualification unverified.

events.summary: Use the smallest safe manual-recovery policy permitted by the plan: validate and retain an orphan RunRecord, publish one terminal ExecutionFailed recovery-required Result, and reject all later execution attempts through the existing Result guard. Do not synthesize a Result from incomplete evidence or rerun the recipe automatically.

2D-041 is resolved after the Debug and Release focused contract passed normal publication, Result-write-failure cleanup, process termination after RunRecord publication, first-restart manual recovery without rerun, orphan retention, and second-restart duplicate rejection with unchanged Result bytes. The issue, reconciliation, handoff, stable contract, and documentation map preserve the owner/call path, policy, D-drive evidence, self-evaluation, and explicit unverified operational boundaries. No Original repository mutation occurred.
